_comment: B601-RS joint limits (radians) from the vendor RS URDF (rebotarm_ros2/src/rebotarm_bringup/description/urdf/00-arm-rs_asm-v3.urdf, fetched 2026-07-26). NOTE: joint2/joint3 are ASYMMETRIC [0, 3.14] in the URDF; positions are relative to the motors' physical set_zero calibration, so verify the arm's zero convention against /rebotarm/joint_states at the bench before the first live move (the M3b look poses assume joint2 can go negative).
